name: fsso-polling
help: Configure FSSO active directory servers for polling mode.

status.name: status
status.help: Enable/disable polling for the status of this Active Directory server.

server.name: server
server.help: Host name or IP address of the Active Directory server.

default-domain.name: default-domain
default-domain.help: Default domain managed by this Active Directory server.

port.name: port
port.help: Port to communicate with this Active Directory server.

user.name: user
user.help: User name required to log into this Active Directory server.

password.name: password
password.help: Password required to log into this Active Directory server.

ldap-server.name: ldap-server
ldap-server.help: LDAP server name used in LDAP connection strings.

logon-history.name: logon-history
logon-history.help: Number of hours of logon history to keep, 0 means keep all history.

smbv1.name: smbv1
smbv1.help: Enable/disable support of SMBv1 for Samba.

options.name: enable
options.help: Enable support of SMBv1 for Samba.

options.name: disable
options.help: Disable support of SMBv1 for Samba.

smb-ntlmv1-auth.name: smb-ntlmv1-auth
smb-ntlmv1-auth.help: Enable/disable support of NTLMv1 for Samba authentication.

options.name: enable
options.help: Enable support of NTLMv1 for Samba authentication.

options.name: disable
options.help: Disable support of NTLMv1 for Samba authentication.
